scope: DNA sequence processing and molecular design
Genome assembly, alignment, annotation and variants
Population genetics, GWAS and inherited-disease research
Epigenomics, regulatory DNA and DNA language models
Microbial/viral genomes, plasmids and mobile genetic elements
Plant, ancient DNA, mitochondrial and long-read workflows
Necessary support for retained DNA analysis workflows
limits: Publicly discoverable and accessible sources only; private, unindexed, removed and future skills are not exhausted.
SKILL.md path counts include mirrors, examples, legacy and non-DNA content; they are not unique workflow counts.
Repository search is a lead inventory, not a claim that every returned repository contains an AI skill. No keyword or repository name alone establishes functional equivalence.
Initial and supplemental web lookups are also cached; only queries with preserved exact query strings are enumerated here.
No LLM selection benchmark, full pipeline validation, or validation of all scientific assertions was performed.
